posts.title: Advancing Student Mental Health at Community Colleges: Research, Practice, and Pathways Forward

summary_en: A free 2-hour live webinar from the Center for Collegiate Mental Health (CCMH) and The Hope Center for Student Basic Needs. Using CCMH data, it compares the mental health needs and counselling services of community colleges with four-year institutions, covering data-informed decision making, reducing stigma, expanding access to care, supporting commuter-based students, and coordinating support across campus and community partners. Held Thursday 10 December 2026, 12:00-14:00 Eastern Time (01:00-03:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 11 December), fully online via Zoom, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. No CEU; a recording will be available to registrants. Aimed at counselling centre staff, clinicians and higher-education professionals working in collegiate mental health.
summary_zh: CCMH 與 The Hope Center for Student Basic Needs 合辦免費 2 小時網上研討會，以 CCMH 數據比較兩年制／社區學院與四年制大學輔導中心的學生心理健康需要，探討數據主導決策、減低污名、擴大求助途徑、支援通勤學生，以及校園與社區協作。2026 年 12 月 10 日（星期四）美東時間 12:00–14:00 舉行（香港／澳門時間 12 月 11 日星期五凌晨 1:00–3:00），全程 Zoom 線上直播，費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。不設 CEU；設錄影重溫，登記後可收看。對象為大專院校輔導中心人員、臨床心理學家、輔導員、社工及高等教育學生心理健康工作者。
